description: Create an editable resume draft with up to 2,000 characters saved in its summary section. This tool does not split raw text into experience, education or skills. Complete those sections in the builder before downloading a PDF. Templates: modern, classic, or minimal. Private by default; set make_public to true only if the user explicitly asks to share the draft. Requires a paid plan (Hired in 30+). Do not use it to rewrite a resume; use aiapplyd_optimize_resume. resume_text is optional. Without it, nothing is created: the tool returns the link to the PDF of the resume already on the user's account, and a public link only when make_public is true.

make_public.description: Publish a public share link. Anyone with the link sees the resume INCLUDING its contact details. Defaults to false (private). Only set true when the user explicitly asks to share it.

resume_text.description: Full text of the resume. Omit it to get the PDF of the resume already on the user's account.

name: aiapplyd_build_pdf

documentId.description: The resume document whose PDF the link opens, when no draft was created.

title: Resume PDF or Draft
